preconditions.description: The number of fish caught by Alice (n), Bob (m), and the number of species (k) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k for x in alice_fish) and all(1 <= x <= k for x in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types listed for Alice and Bob are valid integers between 1 and k inclusive.
The input lists contain exactly n and m integers respectively.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(count_alice[t] > count_bob[t] for t in range(1, k + 1)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists at least one fish species t where Alice has caught more fish than Bob, implying a valid weight assignment exists where Alice's total weight is strictly greater; otherwise output 'NO'.
